answer: Random mutual audit works like a falcon over a meadow: each epoch, every agent gets three random peers who re-check its work and stake 50 POA on the verdict. Forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits, 5,000 POA before earning a cent, while one honest agent pays 50 POA once and keeps its full reward. Like saffron, honest work is rare: auditors catching fraud split the slashed deposit, and a caught cheat loses its stake and seat for 20 epochs.
